items.subject: smartphone battery reference

support_spans.exact_text: Smartphones typically feature lithium-ion or lithium-polymer batteries due to their high energy densities . Batteries chemically wear down as a result of repeated charging and discharging throughout ordinary usage, losing both energy capacity and output power, which results in loss of processing speeds followed by system outages.
support_spans.prefix: e 7 . An adapter reserving the charging port can retrofit the plug. Battery-powered, wireless Bluetooth headphones are an alternative. Those tend to be costlier however due to their need for internal hardware such as a Bluetooth transceiver and a battery with a charging controller, and a Bluetooth coupling is required ahead of each operation.
